recipes.name: AnimateDiff
recipes.summary: AnimateDiff is the classic motion-module approach to text-to-video: it animates existing Stable Diffusion image models by inserting a trained temporal module, rather than training a video model from scratch.

recipes.name: Astra
recipes.summary: Astra is an interactive world model with camera control built over a Wan2.1 backbone: from a single image it rolls out navigable world video following camera actions.

recipes.name: Being-H0.5
recipes.summary: Being-H0.5 is BeingBeyond's 2B-parameter cross-embodiment VLA policy.

recipes.name: CameraCtrl
recipes.provider: The Chinese University of Hong Kong / Shanghai AI Laboratory
recipes.summary: CameraCtrl pioneered plug-and-play camera control for text-to-video diffusion: it trains a camera encoder over Plücker embeddings so trajectories can steer generation without retraining the base model.

recipes.name: CogVideoX
recipes.summary: CogVideoX is Zhipu AI's open video generation family, one of the most widely used open T2V/I2V baselines. This catalog entry serves three runnable variants — 2B text-to-video, 5B text-to-video, and 5B image-to-video — through in-tree runti…

recipes.name: Cosmos Transfer 2.5
recipes.summary: Cosmos Transfer 2.5 does controlled world-to-world translation: it takes structured control inputs (e.g. edge maps or simulation renders) and generates photoreal world video that follows them — the sim-to-real arm of the Cosmos family.

recipes.name: Depth Any Panoramas
recipes.summary: Depth Any Panoramas (DAP) is Insta360's metric depth estimator for panoramic images — full 360° depth from a single equirectangular input.

recipes.name: Depth Anything 3 Metric Prior
recipes.summary: Depth Anything 3 Metric Prior is the metric-depth head of ByteDance Seed's Depth Anything 3, integrated as an independent geometry prior with verified runner status. The recorded checkpoint is depth-anything/DA3METRIC-LARGE, and it is the…

recipes.name: Depth Anything V1
recipes.provider: TikTok / The University of Hong Kong
recipes.summary: Depth Anything V1 is the foundation model for relative monocular depth that popularized large-scale unlabeled-data depth training.

recipes.name: Depth Anything V2
recipes.provider: TikTok / The University of Hong Kong
recipes.summary: Depth Anything V2 is the sharper, synthetic-data-trained successor to V1, integrated here as a metric/monocular depth prior with verified runner status. The recorded checkpoint is depth-anything/Depth-Anything-V2-Large; the shared priors f…

recipes.name: DIAMOND
recipes.provider: University of Geneva / University of Edinburgh / Microsoft Research
recipes.summary: DIAMOND (DIffusion As a Model Of eNvironment Dreams) trains reinforcement-learning agents entirely inside a diffusion world model — its Atari agents and playable CS:GO world model made diffusion world models famous (NeurIPS 2024).

recipes.name: DualCamCtrl
recipes.provider: The Hong Kong University of Science and Technology (Guangzhou) (EnVision Lab)
recipes.summary: DualCamCtrl controls video generation with a camera trajectory plus a depth image: the RGB and depth conditions together pin down scene geometry so the generated camera move stays physically grounded.

recipes.name: DUSt3R
recipes.summary: DUSt3R made unconstrained two-view 3D reconstruction easy: feed it two images — no calibration, no poses — and it directly regresses aligned pointmaps.
tasks: feed-forward multi-view 3D reconstruction and geometry estimation

recipes.name: FantasyWorld
recipes.summary: FantasyWorld does geometry-consistent world modeling by unifying video and 3D prediction: from an image it produces camera-controllable world video that stays geometrically coherent. Two variants are recorded — the verified Wan2.1 pipeline…
aliases: Geometry-Consistent World Modeling via Unified Video and 3D Prediction

recipes.name: FlashWorld
recipes.summary: FlashWorld generates 3D scenes in seconds: from one image (plus optional prompt) it produces a camera-navigable 3D scene rather than a flat clip.
tasks: fast 3D scene generation from image or text

recipes.name: GeoCalib
recipes.summary: GeoCalib estimates camera calibration and the gravity direction from a single image by combining geometric optimization with deep learning.

recipes.name: GigaBrain-0
recipes.summary: GigaBrain-0 is GigaAI's 3.5B VLA foundation policy with subtask prediction, released as GigaBrain-0-3.5B-Base and the 0.1 refresh under Apache-2.0.

recipes.name: HunyuanWorld-Mirror
recipes.summary: HunyuanWorld-Mirror is Tencent's universal 3D reconstruction model: feed it images and it returns point clouds, Gaussian splats, depth, normals, and camera parameters in one pass.

recipes.name: HY-WorldPlay
recipes.summary: HY-WorldPlay is Tencent's real-time interactive world video model: starting from an image, it follows pose/action input to roll the world forward — the interactive arm of the Hunyuan world stack.

recipes.name: Infinite-World
recipes.summary: Infinite-World is MeiGen-AI's long-horizon world video model: from one image it navigates and extends a world over long durations.

recipes.name: InSpatio-World
recipes.summary: InSpatio-World is a 1.3B video-conditioned world generator: given a video and a target trajectory it synthesizes trajectory-conditioned novel views of the same world.

recipes.name: InSpatio-WorldFM
recipes.summary: InSpatio-WorldFM is a 3D world foundation model for spatial intelligence and frame generation, released with confirmed code and weights (inspatio/WorldFM on Hugging Face, Apache-2.0).

recipes.name: Kairos Sensenova
recipes.summary: Kairos Sensenova is SenseTime's embodied world-model video generator: a 4B model covering text-, image-, and text+image-to-video with a robot-oriented distilled recipe.

recipes.name: LingBot-World
recipes.summary: LingBot-World is Robbyant's camera-controlled world video model.

recipes.name: LoGeR
recipes.summary: LoGeR reconstructs 3D scenes with camera trajectories and point clouds from input views, and is one of the verified 3D routes in this catalog: checkpoint-backed Studio inference produced finite poses, depth, and a 601,570-vertex point clou…

recipes.name: LongVie 2
recipes.summary: LongVie 2 is the second-generation controllable long-video framework from the Vchitect team, and the verified member of the pair in this catalog: Studio's default four-GPU torchrun USP route completed a checkpoint-backed run on 2026-07-28,…

recipes.name: Lyra
recipes.summary: Lyra is NVIDIA's generative world model family for exploration: from an image or video (Lyra-1) or from actions (Lyra-2) it produces an explorable world video.

recipes.name: Matrix-Game 2.0
recipes.summary: Matrix-Game 2.0 is Skywork's real-time-oriented interactive world model generation: an auto-regressive diffusion design that follows keyboard/mouse actions across game scenes. The in-tree runner was checked with a 15-latent-frame short run…

recipes.name: Matrix-Game 3.0
recipes.summary: Matrix-Game 3.0 is the third Skywork generation, pushing interactive world video to higher resolution with few-step inference.

recipes.name: Metric3D
recipes.summary: Metric3D recovers metric-scale depth from a single image by normalizing images into a canonical camera space, which lets one model generalize across cameras.

recipes.name: MolmoAct2
recipes.summary: MolmoAct2 is AI2's second-generation action reasoning model with an unusually broad Apache-2.0 checkpoint zoo: base, Think (depth-reasoning), DROID (Franka), Bimanual YAM, SO100/101, and LIBERO variants are all confirmed. WorldFoundry port…

recipes.name: MonST3R
recipes.summary: MonST3R extends the DUSt3R pointmap approach to dynamic scenes: it estimates per-timestep geometry directly from video, recovering shape and motion without a static-scene assumption.
tasks: geometry estimation in the presence of motion

recipes.name: MotionCtrl
recipes.summary: MotionCtrl is a unified, flexible motion controller for video generation: it controls camera motion and object motion independently in one model (SIGGRAPH 2024).

recipes.name: NeoVerse
recipes.summary: NeoVerse is a 4D world model built as a native assembly over canonical Wan components plus model-specific control and reconstruction roles: it enhances world generation with 4D-aware conditioning.
tasks: 4D world modeling from in-the-wild monocular videos

recipes.name: OpenVLA
recipes.summary: OpenVLA is the widely used open 7B vision-language-action model (MIT license): a Prismatic-based VLM fine-tuned on Open X-Embodiment robot demonstrations to predict discretized actions. Both openvla-7b and the LIBERO-10 fine-tune are confi…

recipes.name: Prior Depth Anything
recipes.summary: Prior Depth Anything is a depth-completion prior: it takes any coarse or sparse metric-depth prior plus an image and refines them into a dense, sharper metric depth map.

recipes.name: ReCamMaster
recipes.summary: ReCamMaster re-renders an existing video along a new camera trajectory — camera-controlled generative rendering from a single video.
aliases: Camera-Controlled Generative Rendering from A Single Video

recipes.name: RoboFlamingo
recipes.summary: RoboFlamingo adapts the OpenFlamingo vision-language model into a robot imitation policy: a lightweight policy head turns the VLM's visual-language features into actions.

recipes.name: SCOPE
recipes.summary: SCOPE is an interactive game world model over a Wan backbone: image plus per-step actions in, game-world video out (paper arXiv 2605.23345).

notes: Unified HuggingFace repo contains SCOPE DiT shards, UMT5-XXL text encoder, Wan2.2 VAE, and tokenizer files.

recipes.name: Show-o
recipes.summary: Show-o (Xie et al., Show Lab at NUS with ByteDance, arXiv 2408.12528) is a single 1.3B transformer that unifies multimodal understanding and generation. It is initialized from Phi-1.5 and, unlike systems that attach a separate diffusion ex…

recipes.name: Solaris
recipes.summary: Solaris is a multi-agent interactive video world model from NYU's VisionX group (paper arXiv 2602.22208): multiple agents act inside one generated world.

notes: Official Solaris Orbax checkpoint bundle containing solaris.pt, clip.pt, and vae.pt.

recipes.name: Splatt3R
recipes.summary: Splatt3R predicts a 3D Gaussian splat scene directly from an uncalibrated image pair — zero shot, no camera parameters, no per-scene optimization.

recipes.name: StarVLA
recipes.summary: StarVLA is a Lego-like modular VLA framework; this catalog entry is GPU-validated: the official QwenOFT predict_action ran on an 80GB CUDA GPU with the local Qwen3-VL-OFT-LIBERO-4in1 checkpoint and Qwen3-VL-4B base VLM. A WM4A world-action…

recipes.name: Step-Video-T2V
recipes.summary: Step-Video-T2V is StepFun's large open text-to-video model (30B parameters upstream, MIT weights at stepfun-ai/stepvideo-t2v). In WorldFoundry the public pipeline is assembled from native role-based components with the shared diffusion run…

recipes.name: VGGT-Omega
recipes.summary: VGGT-Omega is the extended VGGT release published under facebook/VGGT-Omega, covering 3D reconstruction, Gaussian splatting, and novel view synthesis.

recipes.name: VMem
recipes.summary: VMem is an interactive video scene generation model with a surfel-indexed view memory: as you navigate a scene, it remembers which surfaces were seen from where, keeping new views consistent with the past.

recipes.name: Wan2.1
recipes.summary: Wan2.1 is Alibaba Tongyi Lab's open video generation family and the backbone of a large part of this catalog — many world-model and control entries build on it. Four variants are recorded here: T2V 1.3B, T2V 14B, and I2V 14B at 480p and 72…

recipes.name: Wan2.2

recipes.name: Warp-as-History
recipes.summary: Warp-as-History (WAH) is a camera-controlled image-to-video method: it warps the input image along the requested camera path and treats those warps as the generation history that a video model then refines.

recipes.name: WorldCam
recipes.summary: WorldCam, from KAIST's CV Lab with Adobe Research and MAUM AI, is an interactive world model with camera-pose control for long-horizon game video.

recipes.name: WorldCrafter
recipes.summary: Reuses shared Helios transformer, scheduler, latent preparation and VGGT layers.

recipes.name: WorldCrafter Base
recipes.summary: WorldCrafter Base is a world model from Tencentarc. The catalog records it for text-to-video, image-to-video, camera-controlled-video, and world-model.

recipes.name: WorldCrafter Fast
recipes.summary: WorldCrafter Fast is a world model from Tencentarc. The catalog records it for text-to-video, image-to-video, camera-controlled-video, and world-model.

recipes.name: YUME

recipes.name: ZeroScope
recipes.summary: ZeroScope is a community fine-tune of ModelScopeT2V optimized for watermark-free 16:9 video, released in 576w and XL upscale checkpoints by the creator cerspense.

recipes.name: AlayaWorld
recipes.summary: AlayaWorld is a camera-controlled interactive world model for long video: from an image it rolls out world video autoregressively with action control and DA3-backed spatial memory.

recipes.name: AlayaWorld v1.1
recipes.summary: Separate AR and four-step DMD inference for AlayaWorld v1.1 with ViGeo spatial memory.

recipes.name: Astronex-World
recipes.summary: Astronex-World exposes causal and bidirectional camera/action-conditioned video inference.

recipes.summary: ATI (Any Trajectory Instruction) turns trajectory drawing into video control: draw point trajectories over an input image and the Wan2.1-14B-based model animates objects, camera, or both along them.

recipes.name: Causal-Forcing
recipes.summary: Causal-Forcing distills bidirectional video diffusion into a causal, autoregressive generator — including Causal-Forcing++ few-step variants — so video can be generated chunk by chunk or frame by frame.

recipes.name: Cosmos Predict 2

recipes.name: VGGT
recipes.summary: VGGT (Visual Geometry Grounded Transformer, CVPR 2025) is a feed-forward network that infers cameras, depth maps, point maps, and 3D point tracks from one to hundreds of views in a single pass — no per-scene optimization.

recipes.name: ABot-World-0-5B-LF
recipes.summary: ABot-World-0-5B-LF is Amap's interactive world model: give it an image plus actions and it rolls out world video block by block, keeping causal KV state resident between action blocks.

recipes.name: DreamDojo
recipes.summary: DreamDojo is NVIDIA's action-conditioned robot world model: given robot actions in a unified 384-dimensional action space (spanning GR-1, G1, YAM, AgiBot, MANO hand, and latent actions), it dreams the resulting robot-view video.

notes: Expected official subset: DreamDojo 2B GR-1 action-conditioned/post-trained checkpoint.

recipes.name: IRASim
recipes.summary: IRASim (Interactive Real-Robot Action Simulator) generates realistic robot-arm videos from an initial frame plus an action trajectory — a learned simulator for robot data.

recipes.name: LaST-R1
recipes.summary: LaST-R1 is an MIT-licensed VLA policy trained with reinforcement learning. The libero_10 RL checkpoint is staged locally, but WorldFoundry does not yet provide the model-specific rollout adapter needed for inference.

recipes.name: MAGI-2 Preview
recipes.summary: 114B-parameter MoE (256 experts, top-6), ~6B active per token; 10-second preview video at 12.5 fps with 44.1kHz audio.

recipes.name: MiniMax H3
recipes.summary: Joint audio+video generation; 32kHz stereo audio track muxed into the mp4.

recipes.name: Pandora
recipes.summary: Pandora is an early general world model with natural-language actions and video states: it simulates world states as video and lets you steer the simulation with free-text actions at any step.

recipes.name: World Labs Marble 1.1
recipes.summary: World Labs Marble 1.1 is a commercial API for 3D world generation: it produces explorable 3D worlds from prompts, accessed through api.worldlabs.ai.
